facts.fact: Minister Kalil Konaté launched on 25 September 2025 the project to set up the public administration interoperability platform, whose phase 1, running to April 2026, is to interconnect the information systems of 12 ministries.

The Ministry of Digital Transition officially launched the Administration Interoperability Platform (Cybernetica UXP, X-Road based) on 25 September 2025, with twelve pilot bodies in its first phase, including the tax directorate, civil status office, social security fund and Abidjan commercial court; led by SNDI.

Minister Ibrahim Kalil Konate launched the project to build the public administration interoperability platform on 25 September 2025; SNDI's director general says 12 pilot bodies were chosen and phase 1 with Cybernetica and Digital Africa Telecom ends in April 2026.
